Profile Loxoprofen sodium is an NSAID (p.96) given orally for the management of pain and inflammation associated with muscu- loskeletal and joint disorders or operative procedures. Loxopro- fen sodium is given as the dihydrate although doses are ex- pressed in terms of the anhydrous salt. Anhydrous loxoprofen sodium 10 mg is equivalent to about 11.3 mg of loxoprofen so- dium dihydrate. A usual oral dose equivalent to 60 mg of the anhydrous form has been given three times daily.
